events.verdict: Zubac (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball in an attempt to deflect the rebound away from Randle (MIN). Any follow-through contact is deemed marginal.
Edwards (MIN) brings his hand towards Porter Jr.'s (LAC) arm in the post, and the contact is marginal.
Porter Jr. (LAC) initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm, which affects his post shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) and Zubac (LAC) briefly engage and disengage as they position themselves off ball.

Alexander-Walker (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position and avoids any illegal contact as he defends Porter Jr. (LAC) at the end of the drive. Porter Jr. attempts to come to a stop and his ankle turns awkwardly, which causes him to lose his balance on is own accord.
Porter Jr. (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Timberwolves.
Dunn (LAC) avoids making any illegal contact with Conley (MIN) as Conley bobbles the ball upon receiving the pass. Conley gains possession and releases the pass prior to stepping into the backcourt.
Zubac (LAC) cleanly deflects the ball away from Edwards (MIN).  Any ensuing contact after the deflection is considered incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Edwards (MIN) deflects the loose ball away from Dunn (LAC) and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Clippers.
Randle (MIN) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.

Gobert (MIN) brings his arm toward the ball, and he grazes the top of Zubac's (LAC) head after he has released his put back attempt at the rim.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Coffey (LAC) is moving alongside Edwards' (MIN) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Batum (LAC) contests Alexander-Walker's (MIN) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Harden (LAC) briefly grasps and immediately releases Gobert's (MIN) arm during rebounding.
Gobert (MIN) grasps Dunn's (LAC) jersey and quickly releases it as Dunn elevates to pursue the rebound.
Dunn (LAC) slips and falls on his own accord as he begins to dribble the ball in transition. He loses control of the ball and Conley (MIN) cleanly secures the loose ball.
Gobert (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball as he pulls the ball away from Dunn (LAC) during rebounding.
